mapper.sql: fl.id, fl.focus_id, fl.content, fl.measures, fl.next_plan, fl.operator_id, fl.happened_at, fl.created_at, fl.updated_at, fl.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(o.real_name, ''), o.nickname, o.username) AS operator_name
FROM psyche_followup fl LEFT JOIN users o ON o.id = fl.operator_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO psyche_followup (focus_id, content, measures, next_plan, operator_id, happened_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{focusId}, #{content}, #{measures}, #{nextPlan}, #{operatorId}, #{happenedAt}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE fl.focus_id = #{focusId} AND fl.deleted = 0 ORDER BY fl.happened_at DESC, fl.id DESC
